new_changelog.title: Release notes wrap inside the Navigator
items: Long links and release notes wrap within What's new at normal and enlarged text sizes, keeping the complete text readable inside the Navigator.

finding: No source-review blocker. Zero-minimum explicit grid tracks allow shrinkage; anywhere wrapping contributes break opportunities to intrinsic sizing and leaves complete text available. Scoped inherited property reaches news descendants without touching other components. Later existing display/gap rules do not override new track/minimum/wrapping declarations.
qualification: Candidate design is coherent but actual layout, bothviewport100/140, returnednewflags/longURL and normalgate validation remain pending. Source review is not browser proof.
